evidence.quote: Mercy will grant these patients financial assistance presumptively, without the requirement of an application.
Patients who qualify for financial assistance will not be asked to pay more than 21% of the patient’s liability.

If approved, patient will receive the appropriate financial discount on eligible services that were first billed to the patient in the prior 240 days from the date a completed application is submitted to Mercy.

presumptive_eligibility: Third-party tool identifies patients at or below 200% FPL with low propensity to pay and grants a 100% charity adjustment for that encounter without an application.
how_to_apply: Apply verbally or on paper (www.mercy.net/fa); return to Mercy Health, Attention Financial Assistance, 2115 S Fremont Avenue, Suite 5300, Springfield, MO 65804; Fax 417-829-4604; customer service 855-420-7900.
warnings: Exhibit A (FPL table with discount levels by income) is not present in the text, so FPL tier thresholds and the free-care limit for applicants could not be extracted; the 200% FPL figure applies only to presumptive eligibility via the third-party tool, and presumptive eligibility is not used at several communities (JFK, Southwest Missouri, Southeast Missouri, Pittsburg).
Policy says patients will not pay more than 21% of liability (at least 79% benefit), but no FPL range is given for this discount in the text.
The 240 days is a look-back for services first billed before the application date, not a clearly stated application deadline; the policy does not state a deadline to apply.
Policy covers many Mercy communities in MO, AR, OK, KS; JFK Clinic has separate rules in Exhibit B (uninsured only).
Patients are required to exhaust alternate payment options such as applying for Medicaid before financial assistance is considered.
Policy is a multi-state system policy; hospital_state set to MO based on the application return address.
